counting_words.observation: Every hand learns the same words for one through twenty, so a count said in one camp means the same in the next.

tallies.ability_reason: Marks on a stick hold a count after memory fails; stores, debts and days can be checked by anyone.

moon_counting.observation: Watchers count the nights from full moon to full moon and plan gatherings by the moons still to come.

solstice_horizon_markers.observation: Stones on the ridge mark where the sun rises on the longest and shortest days, and elders gather to watch it return.

standard_measures.ability_reason: Everyone measures by the same hand, forearm and basket, so shares, trades and buildings stop turning into quarrels.

owner_marks.observation: Each household scratches its own sign on pots and bundles, so a stored jar is claimed without argument.

clay_counting_tokens.observation: Small shaped clay tokens stand for a jar of oil or a measure of grain, and a pile of them is a count anyone can check.
clay_counting_tokens.ability_reason: Counts no longer live in one keeper's head: stores, debts and dues can be held and checked by anyone who knows the shapes.
clay_counting_tokens.social_consequence: Stewards who hold the tokens gain a quiet authority over what the store is said to contain

specialist_task_assignment.name: Specialists Assigned to One Craft's Problems

focused_error_review.name: Crews Review a Spoiled Batch Together

stamp_seals.observation: A carved stone pressed into wet clay closes a jar with its keeper's mark, and a broken seal shows at once.

paired_record_witnessing.name: A Second Keeper Witnesses Each Record

solar_year_reckoning.observation: Twelve moons and the solstice stones are reconciled into one year, and sowing is set by it rather than by guesswork.

knotted_record_systems.observation: Knots of set kinds and spacing on hanging cords record counts and categories that trained readers can recite back.

token_envelopes.observation: Tokens for a shipment are sealed inside a clay ball and their shapes pressed on its skin, so the count cannot be changed on the road.
token_envelopes.ability_reason: An agreement can travel and wait: a sealed count is proof that no carrier or steward can quietly alter.
token_envelopes.social_consequence: Sealed counts settle disputes that once turned on whose word was stronger

star_rise_markers.observation: The dawn rising of certain stars is watched and named, so the seasons are known even under a cloudy sun.

tens_sixties_bundling.observation: Counters bundle by tens and by sixties, so large stores are reckoned in a few bundles instead of endless marks.

impressed_number_tablets.observation: The envelope becomes a flat tablet with numbers pressed into its face, and the tokens inside are no longer needed.
impressed_number_tablets.ability_reason: Numbers now outlast their keepers on a surface anyone can read, so accounts grow longer and larger than memory could hold.
impressed_number_tablets.social_consequence: Whoever keeps the marks keeps the memory; scribes gain standing while the unlettered must trust what is read back to them

seasonal_news_gathering.name: Travelers Asked Set Questions for News

pictographic_records.ability_reason: The first true records: goods, people and obligations can be written down and read back long after the day they were counted.
pictographic_records.social_consequence: Whoever keeps the marks keeps the memory; scribes gain standing while the unlettered must trust what is read back to them

cylinder_seals.observation: A carved cylinder rolled across wet clay leaves an unbroken band of the owner's scene over the whole seal.

clay_record_tablets.observation: Recorders press signs into prepared clay, and the tablets worth keeping are dried and stored.

standard_sign_lists.observation: Scribes copy agreed lists of signs in fixed order, so a sign written in one town is read the same in another.

balance_beam_weights.observation: A beam balanced on a cord weighs goods against polished stones of agreed weight.

sealed_tablet_contracts.observation: A loan or sale is written on a tablet, witnessed, and rolled with both parties' seals.
sealed_tablet_contracts.social_consequence: Written terms protect the weaker party only as well as the reader who explains them

dedicated_apprentice_observation.name: Masters Observe Apprentices at Set Hours

phonetic_notation.ability_reason: Signs now stand for sounds, so names, foreign words and whole sentences can be written, not just counts and things.

plumb_line_sighting.observation: A weighted cord hangs true beside a sighting pole, so walls rise straight and lines run true across a field.

star_rising_civil_year.observation: A civil year of 365 days, begun at a star's dawn rising, sets the dates of levies, rations and festivals.

written_lore_tablets.observation: Recited lore is copied onto tablets, so a telling no longer dies with the last reciter who knew it.

written_apprentice_instructions.observation: A master's working rules are written out for apprentices, who can check a step without waiting for him.

formal_archives.ability_reason: Records gain keepers, dates and a place on the shelf; what one generation learns the next can find again.

public_schools.ability_reason: Tablet houses train scribes in numbers, not one apprentice at a time, and every trained hand spreads new methods faster.

sealed_tablet_letters.observation: A letter is written, sealed in a clay envelope and carried to a distant house, where its words arrive unchanged.

intercalated_calendar.observation: When the moons drift from the seasons, officials add a month so the calendar and the harvest stay together.

bilingual_sign_lists.observation: Sign lists give each word in two tongues, so a scribe can read what foreigners write.

sworn_interpreters.observation: Interpreters swear before the god to render speech faithfully between peoples who share no tongue.

water_trough_leveling.observation: Water in a long trough shows true level, so canals and foundations fall exactly as intended.

scribal_specialties.observation: Tablet-house graduates specialize as surveyors, accountants or letter-writers, each with their own training.
scribal_specialties.social_consequence: Specialized scribes become indispensable, and their guilds learn to bargain with rulers

area_volume_rules.observation: Rules turn a field's sides into its area and a granary's measure into its grain, so dues and seed are reckoned in advance.

star_hour_tables.observation: Tables name which stars rise through the night, so watches are changed and rites timed in the dark.

reciprocal_tables.observation: Students copy tables of products and reciprocals, and division becomes multiplication by a looked-up number.

tablet_colophons.observation: Each copy ends with the scribe's name, the date and the tablet it was copied from, so errors can be traced.

scribal_copying_tests.observation: Students copy model tablets and teachers correct each sign, so every graduate writes to one standard.

place_value.ability_reason: A sign's position gives its value; large sums, rations and surveys become quick to reckon and easy to check.

worked_problem_tablets.observation: Teaching tablets set a problem, work it step by step and state the answer, so a method can be learned from clay.

square_root_tables.observation: Tables of squares and roots let surveyors and builders size a field or a ramp without trial and error.

prearranged_beacon_chains.observation: Beacons along the heights carry a message agreed in advance, and a raid is known in the capital before nightfall.

consonantal_alphabet.observation: A few dozen signs, one for each consonant, spell any word; a merchant can learn in a season what a scribe learned in years.
consonantal_alphabet.ability_reason: Writing escapes the tablet house: a small sign-set lets ordinary traders and craftsmen read and record for themselves.
consonantal_alphabet.social_consequence: When many can write, the scribes' hold on memory and contracts loosens

dated_omen_records.observation: Signs in the sky are written down with their dates and what followed, and old records are consulted when they recur.

shadow_clock.observation: A marked bar casts its shadow across set hour-lines, so shifts and rites keep the same hours of the day.

outflow_water_clock.observation: Water dripping from a marked vessel measures the hours of night, when no shadow falls.

checked_master_copies.observation: Key tablets are kept as checked master copies, and every new copy is compared against them sign by sign.
